naming_note: Dexterity is the operator-facing name of the model-lane kernel Pillar A extends (model_lane.rs:1-5; DexterityNoOsLaunchCaller/DexterityNormalizedLaunch/dexterity_launch). Operator 2026-07-22: Dexterity is the ACP replacer. Pillar-A operator-facing surfaces use the Dexterity name; stable wire/schema ids keep their own names.
vendor_agnostic_engine_note: VENDOR-AGNOSTIC ENGINE FRAMING (operator 2026-07-22): Handshake is a model/vendor-agnostic engine. Models are called through CLI/terminal today ONLY because Anthropic subscription plans block direct API use; Handshake is the wrapper/engine AROUND the CLI - it owns sandboxing, tool-call gating/stopping (SC MT-011), hooks (SC MT-012), cron/scheduling (SC MT-013), and exposing Handshake API/primitives to models (SC MT-014). Claude and GPT are the first two engines in the wrapper; open-source/other vendors follow. Vendor harness behaviors documented in the research basis were input, not the target; no vendor names in operator-facing surfaces, schemas, or policy vocabulary. If direct API access becomes viable, the CLI lane is swapped without touching the wrapper capabilities.

handshake_product_framing_2026_08_27.product_identity: Handshake is both a model-agnostic IDE/harness and a linked creative-production environment.
handshake_product_framing_2026_08_27.managed_project_graph: SurrealDB-canonical project forest spanning root projects, subprojects, tasks, prototypes, taskboards, work packets, microtasks and execution workspaces.

handshake_product_framing_2026_08_27.loom_role: Loom provides typed, provenance-preserving connectivity across Notes/backlinks, source code, data, media, CKC assets and future Tailor/Studio seams without copying source authority.

turso_wp_local_store_decision.authority_boundary: Never canonical; SurrealDB remains sole main authority.
turso_wp_local_store_decision.activation_gate: MT-401 must first resolve the explicit storage-authority exception. REJECT short-circuits MT-402..408 to validator-checked NOT_APPLICABLE; MT-409 emits a no-code structured rejection projection and MT-410 closes with REJECT. APPROVED_FOR_EVALUATION executes MT-402..409 and comparative MT-410 proof. No automatic rollout.

branches.authority_rejected: No product-code implementation or candidate benchmark; MT-409 joins the branch with a structured no-change projection and MT-410 emits REJECT.
branches.evaluation_approved: MT-402..409 execute in order and MT-410 emits ADOPT or REJECT from comparative production-boundary proof.
